arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Measurement'
  AND (
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alt%'
  )
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, vocabulary_id, concept_name
LIMIT 50

arguments.sql_query:
WITH alt_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Measurement'
    AND standard_concept = 'S'
    AND vocabulary_id = 'LOINC'
    AND concept_name LIKE 'Alanine aminotransferase%'
    AND concept_name NOT LIKE '%/%'
    AND concept_name NOT LIKE '%macromolecular%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS patients_with_alt_measured
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN alt_concepts c
  ON m.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id

SELECT TOP 20 measurement_concept_id, measurement_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.measurement
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(measurement_source_value, '')) LIKE '%alt%'
   OR LOWER(COALESCE(measurement_source_value, '')) LIKE '%alanine%'
GROUP BY measurement_concept_id, measurement_source_value
ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT TOP 20 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN omop.concept c ON m.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%'
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code
ORDER BY n DESC
